study.notes: 2021 conference abstract of PROXYMO (NCT04019561): cotadutide titrated to 300 or 600 ug daily vs placebo, 19 weeks, double blind, 74 randomised approximately equally (per arm n not given), adults with BMI 30 or more and biopsy proven non cirrhotic NASH with fibrosis F1 to F3 and MRI PDFF 10 percent or more; LS mean differences vs placebo with 95 percent CI for the 600 ug arm only (300 ug arm described as dose dependent without numbers); primary endpoint safety, so the efficacy measures are secondary (prespecified not stated in the abstract, FALSE recorded); weight change not reported; sponsor AstraZeneca (cotadutide developer; industry); extracted by the session (S), 2026-10-16

rows.notes: relative hepatic fat fraction, LS mean difference vs placebo at 19 weeks, p<0.05; absolute HFF difference -6.2 [-10.5, -1.8] percentage points also reported
IU/L, LS mean difference vs placebo at 19 weeks; baseline means not in the abstract

json.design: randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2, three arms, 19 weeks

rob.justification: double blind randomised (D1, D2 low); attrition not in the abstract (D3); MRI and laboratory outcomes (D4 low); efficacy reported for the 600 ug arm only (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the 300 ug arm has no numbers
